hypothesis: A small fixed convex mixture of the split-safe E004 FNO forecast and the current measured-input persistence prior will recover at least 0.50 TKE score while losing at most 0.15 Rel-L2 and MVPE score on trajectory-disjoint train-side calibration and audit windows.
comparator: The same frozen E004 FNO with the same frozen E006 SPS interval and w=0.0.

blend.formula: y_w=(1-w)*FNO(x)+w*x in physical u/v/p space, returned in target-normalized space
blend.selection: smallest weight whose calibration and audit gates pass; no validation or SPS selection

interval.note: Use E006 bounds unchanged for every candidate and every post-selection stream; SPS is reported, never tuned.

complementary_stress.comparison: existing E010 FNO result; this model saw real_regime_v1 validation and is stress evidence only
